analysis_request.description: Request sent from Frontend → Backend to analyze code

schema.code: string — the source code to analyze
schema.language: string — one of: python, java, c, javascript
schema.action: string — one of: debug, explain, fix, analyze_all

options.max_suggestions: integer — max number of fix suggestions (default: 3)

example.code:
def add(a, b):
    return a + b
result = add(1, '2')
print(result)

analysis_response.description: Response sent from Backend → Frontend with analysis results

errors.type: string — one of: syntax, runtime, logic, style
errors.severity: string — one of: error, warning, info

explanations.line_start: integer — start line of explained block
explanations.line_end: integer — end line of explained block

summary.overall_assessment: string — brief summary of code quality
